maddeler.e:
تنضوا (form I)
# تَنِضُّوا (taniḍḍū) /ta.nidˤ.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
# تُنَضُّوا (tunaḍḍū) /tu.nadˤ.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
